reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme plugin that provides coordinated day and night visual skins, artwork, layout styling, and lightweight ambience through the client presentation layer.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供包含昼夜场景、鲸鱼角色、组件装饰和轻量动态效果的客户端主题皮肤。
summaries.en: A client-side theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with coordinated day and night scenes, character artwork, component styling, and lightweight ambient effects.

capabilities: changes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI presentation layer
applies day and night visual themes with embedded artwork
modifies client-side CSS, DOM presentation, page title, system colors, observers, timers, and animations
provides lifecycle activation and cleanup through the official plugin interfaces
